description: This file is an HTML document that includes embedded JavaScript code implementing a StringStream class for JavaScript code highlighting in CodeMirror, along with related initialization scripts and documentation.

classes.name: StringStream
classes.description: A JavaScript class for tokenizing strings, used for syntax highlighting in CodeMirror.

methods.name: done
methods.description: Checks if the stream has reached the end of the string.

methods.name: peek
methods.description: Returns the next character without advancing the position.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Returns the next character and advances the position.

methods.name: eat
methods.description: Consumes the next character if it matches the given match parameter.

methods.name: eatWhile
methods.description: Consumes characters while the match condition is true.

methods.name: backUp
methods.description: Moves the position back by n characters.

methods.name: column
methods.description: Returns the current position as a column index.

methods.name: match
methods.description: Attempts to match a pattern at the current position.
